headline: Prakash Industries submits AGM scrutinizer report to exchanges
hook: Scrutinizer report filed for recent meeting
summary: Prakash Industries Limited has formally submitted the scrutinizer's report for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing completes procedural compliance requirements following the shareholder gathering. Such reports provide the official tally of voting results on resolutions presented at the meeting. Indian retail investors holding the stock can review the approved resolutions through exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Confirms voting outcomes of shareholder resolutions.
